one_line: LinkedIn's Marketing API for managing ad campaigns, reporting, audiences, and lead sync on the professional network.
auth_notes: OAuth2 with a LinkedIn developer app. Marketing API access requires applying for the Marketing API program in the developer portal and having a LinkedIn Company Page + Ad account; some products are partner-only.
self_serve_notes: Creating a LinkedIn developer app is free and self-serve; but access to Marketing APIs (Advertising, Reporting, Lead Sync) is gated behind an application/review process in the Developer Portal.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Campaign management, advertising analytics/reporting, matched audiences, lead sync, conversions, company intelligence, audience insights
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for ad account/campaign status changes and lead events (Lead Sync)

existing_mcp.note: No official LinkedIn Marketing API MCP; community MCP servers exist.

evidence.note: Fetched text (3.7KB) confirms Marketing API program scope; access gating from LinkedIn docs

agent_notes: Marketing API approval is the slowest gate in this batch; core profile APIs are open but ads APIs are restricted.
